summary.one_line: The final Markdown set and review protocol align, with six recorded draft advisories and no factual certification.

purpose.evidence: Read all 20 Markdown paths. Eight RU/EN page pairs have identifiable reader questions: landing pages route readers, about/contributing explain the project and participation, player/modding pages introduce tasks, and formats pages summarize file types. All 16 site pages explicitly say status: draft; this does not certify that each title is fully delivered.

structure.evidence: Compared the 16 frontmatter records with CONTRIBUTING: two landing, four meta, four explanation, four how-to and two reference pages, with matching types in each language pair. Section headings and links exist; the how-to pages still need complete examples before promotion from draft.

specificity.evidence: Read each article pair and the four repository documents. The player package table distinguishes .pak/.h5u, Lua and DLL; verification names a SHA-256 command and labels its path illustrative. The installation and verification drafts remain general, as listed in findings. I did not check claims against a game installation.

reproducibility.evidence: README's build/check/test sequence matches package.json; CONTRIBUTING's review:info, review:attest, review:gate and prepare scripts are present, and the hook delegates to review:gate. Machine checks were reported passing by the parent. Game procedures in both how-to pairs are incomplete drafts, recorded as advisories; none was executed in Heroes V.

evidence.evidence: All 16 site pages remain draft, none claims verified_on or sources, and README/CONTRIBUTING explicitly say machine success does not prove facts. NOTICE lists font source URLs and asset provenance, but I did not verify external URLs, image creation history, or game-format claims. The format reference lacks adjacent evidence, recorded as advisories.

applicability.evidence: Compared each RU/EN technical pair: getting-started distinguishes original game, expansions and Universe; installation defers destinations to the relevant mod/build; verification labels .\bin\H5_Game.exe as an example. No article claims one build's observations apply to all versions. Actual game compatibility was not tested.

translations.evidence: Checked all eight reciprocal RU/EN frontmatter pairs, matching content_type/status/faction and corresponding headings, tables, caveats and links. README, CONTRIBUTING, AGENTS and NOTICE include matching RU/EN project instructions. Build/link checks were reported passing; no independent external translation verification was performed.

maintenance.evidence: CONTRIBUTING owns the article standard, AGENTS/README point to it, package.json invokes Python and Node checks, and review:info enumerates all 20 cumulative Markdown paths. Existing draft status remains visible; the reviewer must revisit final diff after changes. I did not treat this report as factual certification or cryptographic proof.
